cues.text: Thick, yellow-green mist chokes a stagnant swamp.
On the left, a bipedal reptile with a spiked crest stands among ferns, looking toward a massive, gnarled tree.
Pale moss and tangled vines drape from the tree's twisting branches.
Its sprawling roots sink into a bright layer of glowing green slime.

beats.note: A swamp bathed in yellow-green mist. A massive tree stands in the center.
A blue-green, bipedal reptile is visible on the left, standing among ferns.
The camera pans slowly right across the misty swamp.
Vines and moss hang from the giant tree's twisted branches.
The tree's roots spread into a bright green, glowing slime covering the ground.
